lesson_title: Not Too Hot, Not Too Cold
hook_text: Sit too close to the fire and you burn. Sit too far and you freeze. The Earth sits in just the right spot.
clip_script: A freezing night in the Drakensberg. Bongani sits right next to the fire: too hot! Amahle sits far away: too cold! Thabo sits in the middle: just right. Now swap the fire for the Sun. Venus is too close: hotter than an oven. Mars is too far: frozen. Earth sits in the middle, where water stays liquid and life can grow. Add a blanket of air to keep us warm at night, and you have home.
visual_style: Whiteboard campfire with three learners on logs: one too close and sweating, one too far and shivering, one in the middle smiling, then the same picture turned into the Sun with Venus, Earth and Mars at the three distances.
mood: Cosy and thoughtful, like a story around a fire on a cold night.
pacing: The campfire first, then Venus too hot and Mars too cold, then what makes the Earth just right for life.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and explain why the Earth is just right for life.
